testCases.title: Verify product detail page display after clicking on a product
steps: Navigate to the overview or category page.
Click on a product listed on the page.
expectedResults: The product detail page is displayed.

testCases.title: Verify product information display on product detail page
steps: Navigate to the product detail page.
Check for the display of product image.
Check for the display of product name.
Check for the display of product description.
Check for the display of product price.
Check for the display of category badge.
Check for the display of brand badge.

testCases.title: Verify related products display and clickability
steps: Navigate to the product detail page.
Check for the display of related products below the main product information section.
expectedResults: The related product detail page is displayed after clicking a related product.
